happy national technician appreciation week to those who's hard work keeps our communities moving forward!

June 14 - 20

"CELEBRATING TECHNICIANS THAT KEEP US MOVING"

National technician Appreciation Week serves as an important time for America to recognize the highly skilled professionals who keep commercial vehicles running safely and efficiently. Organized by the American trucking Association (ATA), this annual initiative shines a necessary spotlight on the demanding, behind-the-scenes role that fleet technicians play in supporting the nation’s supply chain. By performing critical maintenance, diagnostics, and repairs under exacting safety standards, these dedicated individuals ensure that delivery vans, big rigs, and emergency response vehicles remain road-ready. Their deep technical expertise and attention to detail protect drivers and the traveling public alike, effectively translating complex mechanical problem-solving into uninterrupted logistics productivity. Ultimately, the week provides the transportation industry and the general public a unified opportunity to voice their gratitude for these unsung heroes whose hard work keeps our communities moving forward.

Truck country and stoops freightliner - western star appreciate all of the hard work our technicians do!
